idealClient.chainRule: same normalized name found at 3 or more places in one campaign

phone_unanswered_reviews.rule: at least 2 of the last 30 reviews (the 30 most recent by publishedAt) labelled PHONE_UNANSWERED by the review-labelling task

booking_wait_reviews.rule: at least 2 of the last 30 reviews (the 30 most recent by publishedAt) labelled BOOKING_OR_WAIT

no_online_booking.rule: no booking widget or booking link on the website or the Maps listing; no website at all counts as none on the website (evidence: no website listed)

reviews_unreplied.rule: more than half of the last 30 reviews (the 30 most recent by publishedAt) have no owner reply

category_match.rule: Maps category matches one of categoryKeywords

multiple_doctors_services.rule: website or listing names 2+ doctors or 3+ treatments

mobile_number.rule: listing or website phone normalizes to a Pakistani mobile number (+923…)

whatsapp_link.rule: wa.me or api.whatsapp.com link found on the website or listing

decision_maker_name.rule: owner or lead doctor name found on the website or in business context

premium_area.rule: lead area matches one of premiumAreas

active_marketing.rule: active social profile linked, or business context mentions paid ads
